# tritonctl vpc

Manage VPCs

Subcommands: list, show, create, update, delete

Usage: `tritonctl vpc [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl vpc list

List your VPCs

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl vpc list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl vpc show

Show one VPC

Usage: `tritonctl vpc show [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: VPC name, uuid, or prefix

## tritonctl vpc create

Create a VPC in the project

Usage: `tritonctl vpc create [OPTIONS] --name <NAME>`

- `--name <NAME>` (required)
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`
- `--ipv4-block <IPV4_BLOCK>`: IPv4 CIDR block (one of ipv4-block / ipv6-block required)
- `--ipv6-block <IPV6_BLOCK>`: IPv6 CIDR block

## tritonctl vpc update

Rename a VPC or change its description

Usage: `tritonctl vpc update [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: VPC name, uuid, or prefix
- `--name <NAME>`
- `--description <DESCRIPTION>`

## tritonctl vpc delete

Delete a VPC. Refused while it still has subnets

Alias: rm

Usage: `tritonctl vpc delete [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: VPC name, uuid, or prefix
- `-n, --dry-run`: Print what would change and stop
- `-y, --yes`: Answer yes to the confirmation. The summary still prints
- `--keep-going`: Keep executing after a step fails
